info.description: Retry-safe commands for planning, execution, inventory, quality, and exception resolution.

get.summary: Read server-owned section event history and open violations
get.description: Returns stage-event evidence and open routing violations for the section's configured stage boundaries. The projection is read-only and rebuildable from the execution ledger.

get.summary: Read rebuildable section support projection (output + WIP)
get.description: Secondary workstation cards. todayOutput aggregates first-success PrintJobs (SENT|SIMULATED, sequence 1) at this section for a UTC calendar day (query date=YYYY-MM-DD). materials are hop inventory (bound-step positions minus first-success print here). lotPlans carry ceil(lot.requiredProductionQuantity / lot.labelPackSize) for Lot Progress — the denominator is the lot plan, not hop occupancy. staff and expectedOutput stay null until product-owned sources exist.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: UTC calendar day for today's output (default current UTC date)

post.summary: Bind a station to an explicit stage step
Add a versioned work instruction

get.summary: Read production-line umbrellas for the Section tree
get.description: A ProductionLine owns Sections; multiple Sections may belong to one line. The collection carries no Station identity; a StationScreen is the published state of a Line.

post.summary: Create a production-line umbrella for the Section tree
post.description: A ProductionLine owns Sections; multiple Sections may belong to one line. The created line has no Stations yet. Line codes are unique within the deployment.

get.summary: Read station-screen line instances scoped to the caller
get.description: 1 line = 1 station screen. Admin (operations.manage) sees all lines; every other subject sees only lines where they are the active leader, the assigned leader, or hold an ACTIVE operator assignment. This collection is the login-landing source: one allowed line lands directly, several show the picker.

post.summary: Register a station-screen line under a leaf work process
post.description: 1 line = 1 station screen (L-1). The line must attach to a leaf WorkProcess; parent counts roll up (L-2/L-4). assignedLeaderId is required at creation time (L-5); the active leader defaults to the assigned leader. lineCode must be uppercase alphanumeric with dashes (e.g. DEC-LS-01) and is unique across the deployment.

get.summary: Read the leader switcher attention flags for a line
get.description: Red-dot evidence (L-12): openViolations counts OPEN routing violations at the line's sub-stage, stuckWip counts batch positions parked there longer than 8 hours, and unfilledHour reports whether today has a daily-sheet row for the line's work process. Non-admin callers must lead or run the line.

post.summary: Create a draft project

get.summary: Read a project and its planning snapshot
get.description: Returns the active Project snapshot, model quantities, Parts, Parts List versions, Lot, and execution lineage. Demand allocation, PMRS placeholder, and MaterialRequirement properties were removed by the user-approved 2026-09-25 v1 scope amendment.

get.summary: List batches and their current positions

post.summary: Create a planned batch and initial position projection (API/tests; UI releases mint automatically)

get.description: Returns current positions together with batch, lot, part, and ordered route-step identity needed by execution workstations. The projection is rebuildable from the execution ledger and is not a second source of truth.

post.summary: Record a forward-only stage event or routing violation
Record receiving or issuance evidence
post.description: Records inventory movement without a MaterialRequirement link; materialRequirementId is retired and rejected.

get.summary: Read routing violations and their resolution state
Resolve a scanned batch code into an open quality inspection
get.description: Journey D scan-first resolve. Requires quality.resolve. Fail-closed when the gate stage is not in the subject's allowedStages.

200.description: Server-owned quality inspections with batch and latest-decision evidence.

post.summary: Open a quality inspection for a batch

get.summary: Read the subject directory for leader/operator pickers
get.description: Admin-only identity read (identity.read) backing the line-screen management pickers: assigned/active leader selection and operator assignment. Returns opaque subject ids plus display/email snapshots; never provider identifiers.

get.summary: Read dashboard counts derived from server ledgers
Read the server-owned line reporting projection

patch.summary: Update a line (label, code, leaders, order, enable state)
patch.description: Admin management of the line identity. The cover flip (sick-day active leader) is a patch of activeLeaderId; the assigned leader assignment stays untouched (L-5). Requires If-Match with the current rowVersion; 412 on mismatch.

delete.summary: Soft-disable a line and end its active operator assignments
delete.description: Soft-hide (standard §6): the line row is disabled and its ACTIVE operator assignments end; GET /lines no longer returns it and reads of attention return 404. Evidence stays in audit. Requires If-Match.

post.summary: Assign an operator to a line (single-line invariant)
post.description: Leader-owned transfer (L-8): the line's active leader (or an admin) assigns an ACTIVE operator. A subject already holding an ACTIVE assignment on another line returns 409 until that assignment ends. The reason is a plain stamp, not a charge-code system.

delete.description: Marks the assignment ENDED with endedAt evidence; rows are never rewritten beyond ending. Only the line's active leader or an admin may end it.

post.summary: Upsert a model allocation and materialize plan-part evidence
post.description: Accepts model identity, planned quantity/UOM/usage basis, and source revision. Demand dimensions marketRegion and demandPurpose are retired and rejected.

post.summary: Create an immutable draft parts-list route version
Release a draft or ready project (mints missing tray batches, then activates PLANNED→ACTIVE)
Create the single planned lot and its part allocation
post.description: A project can have at most one lot. A second distinct lot creation returns a 409 cardinality conflict; idempotent retries replay the original response.

post.summary: Record a quality decision and close or hold the inspection
Resolve a routing violation with an operator note
